content: Let's go see pandas! The news said that two pandas arrived at the zoo last week.
Great! I would like to see cute pandas, too.
We can take the MET and get off at the Zoo Station.
( At the zoo ) Wow! This zoo is really huge.
Yes, you can find hundreds of various animals here. It is the biggest zoo in Taiwan.
Look at the map. It has different areas, such as marine lives, mammals, polar animals and insects.
Where can find the pandas? I think we are here to see the pandas.
We have to go to the mammal area. We are at the gate right now. We need to go straight from here and turn left and go along to the end and make anotherleft turn.
It should take at least 20 minutes to get there. Are there any shuttle buses running place to place around the whole zoo?
